mapper.select: SELECT id, store_id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, manufacture_date, expiry_date, supplier_id, source_type, source_no, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, qty_sold, cost_price, tenant_id FROM ph_inv_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, store_id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, manufacture_date, expiry_date, supplier_id, source_type, source_no, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, qty_sold, cost_price, tenant_id FROM ph_inv_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND drug_id = #{drugId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ls.batch_id, ls.location_id, ls.drug_id, ls.qty, b.warehouse_id, b.expiry_date, b.cost_price, b.batch_no FROM ph_inv_location_stock ls JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = ls.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE ls.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ls.drug_id = #{drugId} AND b.store_id = #{storeId} AND b.quality_status = 0 AND ls.deleted = 0 AND ls.qty > 0 ORDER BY b.expiry_date ASC, b.id ASC, ls.location_id ASC

SELECT ls.batch_id, ls.location_id, ls.drug_id, ls.qty, b.warehouse_id, b.expiry_date, b.cost_price, b.batch_no FROM ph_inv_location_stock ls JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = ls.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE ls.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ls.batch_id = #{batchId} AND ls.location_id = #{locationId} AND ls.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET qty_avail = qty_avail - #{qty}, qty_total = qty_total - #{qty}, qty_sold = qty_sold + #{qty}, version = version + 1, last_issue_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND qty_avail >= #{qty}
UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET qty_avail = qty_avail + #{qty}, qty_total = qty_total + #{qty}, qty_sold = GREATEST(qty_sold - #{qty}, 0), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_batch (store_id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, manufacture_date, expiry_date, supplier_id, source_type, source_no, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, qty_sold, cost_price, tenant_id, creator, updater) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{warehouseId}, #{drugId}, #{batchNo}, #{manufactureDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{supplierId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceNo}, #{qtyTotal}, #{qtyAvail}, #{qtyFrozen}, #{qtySold}, #{costPrice}, #{tenantId}, 'system', 'system')
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET qty_total = qty_total + #{inQty}, qty_avail = qty_avail + #{inQty}, cost_price = #{newCost}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_flow (store_id, batch_id, drug_id, batch_no, flow_type, in_qty, out_qty, balance_qty, biz_type, biz_no, flow_time, operator, remark, tenant_id, location_id, biz_line_id, frozen_delta, unit_cost, creator, updater) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{batchId}, #{drugId}, #{batchNo}, #{flowType}, #{inQty}, #{outQty}, #{balanceQty}, #{bizType}, #{bizNo}, #{flowTime}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{tenantId}, #{locationId}, #{bizLineId}, #{frozenDelta}, #{unitCost}, 'system', 'system')
